headline: Waist-high SSE at a fair angle, glassy morning before the sea breeze — log it early.
today: Best window is dawn to late morning while the NW stays light and it's glassy over the incoming tide to the 9:38 high. It's only 2ft at 6.5s and a fair angle, so keep expectations low — log or groveler, nothing that needs push. Once the S onshore fills in around midday it goes soft and bumpy, so don't sleep in.

daysToWatch.note: Biggest reading of the week, up to 5ft, but it's short-period and cross-on through the day. The 6-7mph NNE cross-off in the evening is your cleanest shot — worth a look if the size holds.
Chest-high SSE at 5.5s with NNE/NE cross-off dawn through morning. Cleanest window of the week — get on it early before the SE swings onshore that evening.
